Macrons

Theme

Money, work & business

finances noun

one’s money matters

also finance, personal finances, my finances, money matters, public finances, household finances

classical

Caes. BG 1.18.4: suam rem familiārem auxisse
Traupman 359: personal finances

rēs familiāris, reī familiāris f.

one’s private means, personal finances

The household’s property and means (Lewis & Short, s.v. familiāris); Traupman gives it for personal finances. To put one’s finances in order, rem familiārem cōnstituere.

Other words

  • rēs pecūniāria, reī pecūniāriae f. — money matters

    also used · classical · Cic. Rosc. Am. 117: reī pecūniāriae socius (Lewis & Short); Traupman 91: sollicitor dē rē pecūniāriā

    Money as a matter of business, as against property in general; the adjective is pecūniārius, financial (see economic).

  • aerārium, aerāriī n. — the public finances, the treasury

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · M-O s.v. finances: public finances (Cic., Tac.)

    Properly the state treasury in the temple of Saturn (see fund).

Examples

  • His rēbus et suam rem familiārem auxisse et facultātēs ad largiendum magnās comparāsse

    By these means he had both enlarged his own fortune and got together great resources for briberyCaes. BG 1.18.4

  • Ūnō verbō, sollicitor dē rē pecūniāriā.

    In a word, I’m worried about my finances.Traupman 91

See also money, budget, economic, resources, finance, fund.
